## About
SmartCam is a proprietary freemium rolling video recorder for Rokid AI Glasses. Free mode saves three-minute interval clips; Pro adds MARK, Total Recall, marked-only saves, and more interval lengths. Camera and microphone permissions are required, and recordings stay on the glasses. Pro uses per-device activation; the upstream documentation currently describes a test/sandbox checkout. This entry distributes the upstream APK, not source code.
